title: Roots Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

services.name: Jiu Jitsu Gis
services.desc: Many women express interest in starting Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, but training can be intimidating given the level of contact. Here at Roots BJJ, our women's program gives a unique opportunity to connect and train with our team of women, in a fun and safe environment. Whether your goals are self defense, competition Jiu-Jitsu, or general fitness, our program will help empower you, and attain those goals. Sign up for a FREE WEEK trial today! Our Women's Brazilian Jiu Jitsu classes are geared towards the beginner and seasoned veteran alike: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu not only teaches a vast array of skill, but also provides a tremendous workout. You can expect to burn 500-1000 calories on an average
